title: Highest temperature in London on May 20?
description:

Any revisions to temperatures recorded after data is finalized for this market's timeframe will not be considered for this market's resolution.

eventMetadata.context_description: Recent ensemble forecasts from global models show Istanbul likely peaking near 20°C on May 21 under a ridge of high pressure and light southerly winds that favor modest warming. This setup underpins the 33 percent market-implied odds for exactly 20°C while the broad spread across 18–22°C outcomes reflects lingering uncertainty in cloud thickness and possible weak frontal passages that could shave several degrees off daytime maxima. Historical May baselines near 22°C place current guidance slightly below normal, with key variables such as boundary-layer moisture and shortwave ridging determining whether readings reach 21–22°C or stay capped at 18–19°C. Fresh model updates expected overnight will clarify these sensitivities ahead of the daily high.
